articles.summary: On Tuesday, June 17, Casella Chairman and CEO John Casella, President Ned Coletta, and Founder and Vice Chairman Doug Casella rang the Opening Bell at the Nasdaq MarketSite in Times Square in recognition of our 50th Anniversary.
articles.title: Casella Rings in 50 Years at Nasdaq

articles.summary: Environmental Technician Eric Patch has become the steady hand behind one of Casella’s first landfill‑based PFAS treatment systems, earning the nickname “the foam whisperer” for his deep understanding of the technology. His journey, from third‑shift truck mechanic to mastering a complex, first‑of‑its‑kind environmental system, reflects more than a decade of hands‑on learning and dedication.
articles.title: Mastering the Machine: Eric Patch on PFAS, Precision, and Purpose

articles.summary: A long-standing partnership between Casella and Chemung County is helping transform landfill gas into renewable natural gas (RNG), creating a valuable energy resource while reducing greenhouse gas emissions. Through collaboration with Waga Energy, the project captures gas generated through the natural decomposition of waste and converts it into lower-carbon energy that can be delivered to the local gas grid.
articles.title: Capturing Opportunity: Turning Landfill Gas into Clean Energy in Chemung, NY

articles.summary: Since joining Casella in 2012, Shaunna Parker has built a career focused on connecting people with opportunity. After starting in Accounts Receivable and gaining insight into operations across the company, she found her calling in Human Resources and now serves as Senior Talent Acquisition Manager. Shaunna is passionate about sharing the Casella story, building relationships, and helping candidates discover meaningful career opportunities.
articles.title: Building Careers, Strengthening Culture: Shaunna Parker's Passion for People

articles.summary: When Lindsey Menard joined Casella in 2020, she stepped into the world of environmental compliance with curiosity, determination, and a desire to make a tangible impact. She now serves as an environmental compliance manager supporting facilities across Vermont and New Hampshire, helping teams navigate regulations, respond to challenges, and keep operations running safely and responsibly.
articles.title: From Permits to Problem Solving: PC&E’s Lindsey Menard

articles.summary: In this episode of Beyond the Bin, Jeff Weld sits down for a special interview with Chairman & CEO, John W. Casella. The two talk about lessons learned during the ongoing Covid-19 pandemic, leaning into our core values in times of crisis, challenges we've faced head-on such as career path opportunities, and what the future might hold for Casella.
articles.title: A Special Interview with John W. Casella

articles.summary: Casella Waste Systems, Inc. and Waga Energy partner to create renewable natural gas from landfill gas at the Chemung County Landfill in Elmira, NY.
articles.title: Casella Unveils New RNG Facility with Waga Energy

articles.summary: In this episode of Beyond the Bin, we have a special interview with Kelley Robinson, Senior Vice President of Human Resources, Bill Baptie, CDL School Instructor, and Sam Joyce, the youngest student to go through the program. They discuss the vision, inspiration, and goals behind the newly launched Casella CDL Training Program. What began as a strategic initiative to fill needed positions within the company has turned into a thriving opportunity for success and growth for Casella employees.
articles.title: Licensed to Thrive: The Casella CDL School

articles.summary: Casella’s Director of Financial Shared Services, Shannon Creed, was recently named one of Waste360’s 2026 40 Under 40. The distinction recognizes inspiring and innovative leaders under the age of 40 who have made significant contributions through excellence in waste, recycling, food waste, and organics management.
articles.title: Shannon Creed Named Waste360 40 Under 40

articles.summary: The 2026 Maintenance & Operations Summit brought together teams from across Casella’s operating footprint for a high‑energy week centered on collaboration, safety leadership, and shared purpose.
articles.title: Safety, Service, and Shared Purpose: 2026 Maintenance & Operations Summit

articles.summary: The Vermont House of Representatives recently honored Casella for its exemplary contributions to the state over the past 50 years. Lawmakers, alongside business and community leaders, celebrated the company's remarkable journey, from a single pickup truck operation in Rutland to a national leader in waste management, sustainability, and community stewardship. The tribute recognized not only the vision and dedication of John and Doug Casella, but also the profound impact Casella has had on Ver...
articles.title: Legislative Tribute: Vermont House Celebrates Casella’s Five Decades of Service

articles.summary: In this episode, we have a special on-the-job interview with Casella driver Dean Ferris, of Scarborough, Maine. Dean goes above and beyond on his waste and recycling routes by greeting customers with a friendly smile, tossing a bone to the neighborhood dogs, lending a hand to those in need, and honking the horn for young Casella super fans. He commits every day to deliver quality service to his customers and embraces all aspects of our Casella core values.
articles.title: Dean Ferris: Going the Extra Mile

articles.summary: On July 22, in partnership with the National Waste and Recycling Association, ReSource Waste Services, and the Boston Fire Department, Casella helped host a battery take-back event in the Boston neighborhood of West Roxbury, MA.
articles.title: Boston Event Spreads Battery Safety Awareness

articles.summary: The partnership between Casella and Portland Mattress Makers is rooted in a shared commitment to durability, resource conservation, and responsible material recovery. By crafting long‑lasting mattresses and working with Casella to ensure those products are properly recycled at the end of their life, the PMM team is helping divert valuable materials from disposal and strengthen the regional circular economy.
articles.title: Stitching Together a More Sustainable Approach with Portland Mattress Makers

articles.summary: At McKean Landfill in Kane, PA, Don Shonts is the steady force behind a complex, fast‑moving operation. His day begins at 4:30 am, opening the facility, lining up rail cars, and giving his team the clear direction they need to keep a 6,000‑ton site running safely and efficiently.
articles.title: Keeping McKean on Track - Division Manager Don Shonts

articles.summary: A standout commitment to community service has earned Casella Oneonta, NY Territory Sales Representative Adam Stoutenburg the honor of being named the Otsego County Chamber of Commerce’s 2026 Volunteer of the Year.
articles.title: Adam Stoutenburg Named Otsego County Chamber of Commerce Volunteer of the Year

articles.summary: When it comes to achieving sustainability goals, education and collaboration can be just as important as infrastructure. Through its collaboration with Casella, UMass Chan Medical School is gaining valuable insights into the recycling process, using data, hands-on learning, and facility tours to help improve waste diversion efforts across campus.
articles.title: Turning Insight Into Impact: How UMass Chan and Casella Are Advancing Campus Sustainability Together

articles.summary: In this episode of Beyond the Bin, we have a special interview with Dan Gagnon, a driver for Casella. When Dan Gagnon decided to quit smoking in 2010 he replaced it with a new habit, running. He never dreamed that more than a decade later he would be using his 17-mile commute as a training opportunity for his seventh marathon, or that he would be helping to improve many other lives and not just his own. Like many Casella drivers, Dan's commitment to service extends far beyond the cab of his t...
articles.title: Dan Gagnon: Running for Life
